interpretation: Halo matched the always-YES baseline: it solved all four YES cases and none of the four NO cases. This is a full-cache capability failure for the balanced R7 v2 task, not evidence about the Significance Matrix mechanism.
limitations: Only eight independent clusters were screened.
The audit is descriptive and post-hoc; no inferential statistic is reported.
Only Halo B0 full cache was executed; no Rineya/R2 or Aegis model and no compression condition ran.
